title: Certified decisions for learned KAHM representations of a smooth two-lag product
scope: Constructed independent-episode mechanism study; not a naturally acquired cohort or general KAHM accuracy benchmark
history_formula: X_j = S_j * (0.9 + U_j), independent S_j uniform on {-1,+1}, U_j uniform on [-0.1,+0.1]

target_formula.irreducible: Y=0.8*V_1*V_2+E, where V is an independent history-law draw hidden from the predictor

noise: E uniform on [-0.05,0.05], independent of every history coordinate
tolerance_rationale: A fixed absolute MSE tolerance in the declared bounded signal units, comfortably above noise variance 0.05^2/3 and below the unconditional target variance; chosen after development-only pilots and before every confirmatory calibration stream
cost_definition: Retained scalar soft-association coordinates; declared KAHM classes only, not runtime or a minimum over all predictors
scaling_fit: All 2048 training histories before geometry fitting; transform later data with frozen extrema; do not clip; constant coordinates map to zero
decoder: BlockBoundedRidge with unpenalized intercept, prediction clipping to target bounds and common sum-of-block-Frobenius-norms budget
selection: Minimum validation MSE within each regime/repetition/retained-prefix; ties broken by first ridge-grid entry; all selections frozen before any calibration generation
partitions: Argmax of each frozen learned KAHM soft-association block, ties by lowest index; history-only, no generated sign labels or future responses
stratum_pairing: Consecutive observations in original episode order within each learned stratum, disjoint pairs; discard one final odd observation per stratum
stratum_mass: Calibration frequency with simultaneous Hoeffding intervals, intersected with the probability simplex; minimize the weighted conditional lower endpoints over that simplex
rare_strata_policy: Zero conditional lower endpoint when fewer than two disjoint pairs
confidence_scope: Joint across BOTH regimes, ALL 20 repetitions, ALL four sample-size prefixes, BOTH retained classes, and ALL upper/unconditional/stratified endpoints
stratified_eta: 0.03/(320*2) per learned partition, class, sample size, regime and repetition; eta/2 for masses and eta/(2*M) for each of M conditional means
primary_lower: Maximum of unconditional and both learned-partition lower endpoints; all three are simultaneously budgeted
upper_only: Cheapest fitted class whose upper endpoint is at most 0.1; failure of an upper endpoint to pass does not exclude its class
minimum_cost: c_low=min cost among classes whose lower endpoint is at most 0.1, c_up=min cost among classes whose upper endpoint is at most 0.1; equal finite endpoints certify minimum feasible cost among the two declared classes; no remaining lower-compatible class certifies joint infeasibility
oracle_use: Known Bayes risk 0.05^2/3 (repairable) and 0.8^2*(0.9^2+0.1^2/3)^2+0.05^2/3 (irreducible) are descriptive reference values only; not used in any endpoint or model selection
reporting: Retain every seed, candidate validation loss, selected model, certificate at every prefix, failure and unresolved decision; no calibration-driven protocol, sample-size, tolerance, partition or model changes
development_disclosure: Five pilot seeds 97001--97005 tested a sign-product target and a smooth product target on separate development-only train/validation samples. They informed this protocol. No pilot calibration sample was generated. Both pilot scripts and outcomes are retained. The confirmatory stream seeds are disjoint.
